test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to complete the given idiom.

cool as ______
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"cool as a cucumber**" means to be very **calm and composed, especially in a stressful situation.**
 
• It is often used to describe someone who remains untroubled and relaxed.
 
• The phrase originates from the fact that cucumbers are cool to the touch, even in hot weather.
 
• Using this idiom correctly can enhance your descriptive language and make your speech or writing more colorful.

Hence, the correct statement is **'*She remained cool as a cucumber during the entire interview.'***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Using idioms like **"cool as a cucumber**" can make your language more engaging and vivid.
 
• Idioms often have cultural significance and can be a fun way to learn about language nuances.
 
• However, it's important to use them correctly to convey the right meaning and avoid confusion.
